audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the content level chart contradicts the why printed beside it. whys[0] says Fiora wins the level-1 short trade but win[0] is Graves. whys[1] gives her the level-2 crit Vital but win[1] is Skill. whys[2] 'the lane levels out into a spacing battle' and whys[3] 'neither side cleanly wins the trade' are marked Fiora. whys[4] gives her level 6 but win[4] is Graves. whys[5] says 'a coinflip rather than a stomp' but win[5] is Fiora. whys[6] hands the late game to Graves but win[6] is Fiora. The packet levelChart matches the whys exactly: Fiora / Fiora / Skill / Skill / Fiora / Skill / Graves.
audit.why: Graves has no Quickdraw at level 1 and only two shells before a reload, so Fiora owns the first two levels. From 3 the dash plus Smoke Screen turn it into a spacing fight. Level 6 is hers because Grand Challenge plus the heal zone beats a spent dash. Two items of resistances and range flip it to him.
audit.corrected: Set the chart to Fiora / Fiora / Skill / Skill / Fiora / Skill / Graves in both layers. Flipped as one atomic group.

audit.why: All four spikes present and correctly placed (1-2, 6, first item, 2+ items). Added the Quickdraw cooldown and its refresh mechanic so the tracking advice is usable.
audit.corrected: Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12s but its cooldown is lowered by every basic attack that connects, so it is not a fixed clock — count his autos.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields say Smoke Screen 'blinds' Fiora's Vital autos — whys[3], mid, spikes[3], wants.foe[1]. Smoke Screen applies no blind and causes no missed attacks.
audit.why: Kit text: 'creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.' It is a nearsight plus an impact slow. Fiora's autos land normally inside it — the problem is that she cannot see him to chase or to place her Lunge.
audit.corrected: Restated as a sight-range cut that makes her lose him mid-chase, which is the real reason not to follow him into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] is titled 'Riposte his Quickdraw' and the full layer's whole framing is 'parry his Quickdraw'. Riposte gains nothing from a dash that applies no crowd control.
audit.why: Quickdraw is a dash granting Armor and MR — it carries no immobilise, so parrying it neither stuns nor blocks meaningful damage. Graves has no hard CC anywhere in his kit, which the content layer already states correctly in 'early'. The worthwhile parry is the point-blank shotgun burst or Collateral Damage.
audit.corrected: Repointed the do at the shotgun burst and said plainly that the dash carries no CC.

audit.why: spikes[3] said 'kites with E and Quickdraw move speed' as if those were two abilities — E is Quickdraw. Tidied while rewriting that line for the Smoke Screen correction. The genuinely useful interaction the page already gets right: pinning him against a wall after the dash is spent, since End of the Line also detonates early on terrain.

edits.before: He chains the E dash and W Smokescreen to blind your Vital autos while you fish for a Lunge — neither side cleanly wins the trade.
edits.after: He chains Quickdraw with Smoke Screen, which shrinks your sight range so you lose him mid-chase — neither side cleanly wins the trade.

edits.before: Drop W Smokescreen to blind your Vital autos and cut your vision during your all-in
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen to shrink your sight range so you lose track of him mid-commit

edits.before: His biggest threat: tanky Graves on Eclipse/BorK kites with E and Quickdraw move speed, blinds your Vital autos in W smoke, and bursts you with shotgun pellets from range.
edits.after: His biggest threat: tanky Graves on Eclipse/BorK kites with Quickdraw — its cooldown drops on every auto — hides in Smoke Screen, and bursts you with pellets from range.

edits.before: Once he has E (his dash) and W Smokescreen online, he can dash away from your Q and blind your Vital autos inside the smoke cloud, so stop chasing into the cloud and farm the wave instead. Your level 6 is the real swing: R marks all four Vitals at once, and if you pin him against a wall after his E is spent, the heal zone and chained Lunges run him down. Track his E cooldown religiously — that dash is the whole matchup, and committing while it is up just feeds him a free kite.
edits.after: Once he has Quickdraw and Smoke Screen online, he dashes out of your Q and the smoke shrinks your sight range so you lose him mid-chase — stop following into it and farm the wave instead. Your level 6 is the real swing: R marks all four Vitals at once, and if you pin him against a wall after his E is spent, the heal zone and chained Lunges run him down. Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1 but drops on every auto he lands, so count his hits, not the clock.

edits.before: Graves wastes Quickdraw — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Parry his shotgun burst instead — the dash carries no CC.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Vitals rotate — reposition so the next one faces your dash.

edits.before: Burning Riposte on poke — your W exists to delete his ONE key spell; waste it and the duel maths flips against you.
edits.after: Without a Vital exposed you have no true damage and no passive heal — walk up only when one is already showing on him.

notes: Worst level chart seen so far in this slice: all seven content rows contradicted their own why text, and the packet chart agreed with the whys on all seven. Flipped the lot. Second real error: Smoke Screen was described in four places as blinding Fiora's autos — it is a sight-range reduction plus an impact slow, no blind, so her attacks land fine inside it and the actual cost is losing sight of him. Third: the full layer's entire framing is 'parry his Quickdraw', but Quickdraw is a plain dash with no CC — Graves has no hard CC at all, so Riposte should be saved for the shotgun burst or Collateral Damage. I corrected the do, but focus.text, tldr, winCon, loading and several breakdown fields still say 'track/parry Quickdraw'; rewriting all of them inside the length band would need a bigger budget than one matchup allows.
